review: 1. Who is this fo,r midgets? The filing cabinet is so utterly small it has to be made for little people. 2. Junk construction out of super thin steel. 3. Arrived dented on the lower drawer. 4. It's TINY! What exactly am I supposed to file in this miniature sized cabinet? 5. How is this super thing metal cabinet $130 bucks? NOT WORTH the cost or my time to box back up and ship. TOTAL 100% china made junk. I'll be a real, american made 50 year old filing cabinet on craiglist for LESS MONEY.
title: JUNK FROM CHINA

review: Ugh I had to replace my casters on my office chair and thought, since i Had a hardwood floor these would be a great replacement. They were easy to install ... BUT.. BUT... They do not roll. They are stiff and it is no better than my previous casters where one was broken... It is so frustrating that I have to buy a new type or something cause they are just horrible and frustrating. I am fighting with my chair when I want to move around.. Don't buy..
title: They don't roll!!!

review: My gas cylinder on my chair broke and it will no longer stay up. I have an non-adjustable standing desk, so sometimes I need it to be high, but then I need it to be regular height for my secondary desk. It clips on easily. Then you tighten the bolt by hand. This is where the problem starts. I can't seem to tighten it enough that it doesn't allow the pipe to slide right through. Maybe if I were lighter? Like 100lbs? When I have time, I will see if my husband can take a wrench to it to fix it. Or I will just have to replace the gas cylinder, since the chair is in otherwise good condition.
title: Says doesn't need tools

review: This unit is not a quality product. I just assembled the product and the ball bearings are already coming off from the track to hold the drawer in place. The unit arrived damaged. The outside structure of the unit is okay but the actual filing cabinet drawers are garbage. Cosmetically the unit looks good. The manufacturer should pre-assemble the tracking mechanism and the side drawers. This would probably cost more money to ship and in production but I am sure it would cause them less returns. I will be returning the unit as it is really not functional long term.
title: Read the reviews carefully.

review: Adhesive side will not stay on. Magnet side only holds minimal weight even though I used a lot of it. I tried to use this on a picture frame to adhere to the side of a filing cabinet.
title: Not worth the money. Poor quality.

review: Not for carpeted floors as stated. Slides around and really isn’t firm enough to support a desk chair
title: Not sturdy

review: Nice but not tall enough. NOT 28 inches. Stops around 24 inches. That’s too low for my standing desk.
title: Wrong height, be careful

review: It literally shakes and wobbles as I type. It's not the wheel adjustment. It's the structure of the thing. It's a piece of junk, and now I need to decide if getting motion sickness as I type is worse than not having a work station at all. I mean, there are a zillion standing desks that are all this same basic style, and they are all probably like this. None of them that I've seen have diagonal cross supports to prevent them from wobbling. But it's literally as I type. Typing should not shake a piece of furniture. Very disappointed.
title: Cheaaaaaaap

review: it's really small, that measurement is not a radius but total. it would be okay for a small stool not an office chair.
title: it's not accurately measured

review: This is flimsy, the wheels don't roll well on hardwood floors, and worst of all, there's a missing screw which means I'm not able to attach
title: Not a sturdy standing desk

review: This is a poorly constructed file cabinet. It certainly would not work well in an office environment. It can work in a home environment, if your expectations are not very high. Also, even though it has wheels, it’s better not to roll it around. I have a printer on top of it and keep it in one place. So it works for me, but most people would certainly want something better. This filing cabinet is made in China and being sold by Chinese company on Amazon.
title: Made in China. Better options abound.

review: this lamp is made in china, looks cheap, and doesn't feel or appear to be high quality. for around fifty dollars i'd expect to get a much nicer desk lamp. not recommended. i was disappointed because i had high hopes based on other reviews.
title: not worth $46

review: I like that these arm rest pads have cooling gel built in. They also fit well on the skinny arms of my office chair. My complaint is that they are way too firm. They just aren't comfortable to me.
title: Not for me

review: I was hoping to use these wheels to allow my office chair to work on low height carpet but these just did not perform as expected; suspect they would be fine on a hardwood/tile floor.
title: Did not work as expected on carpet

review: I love this rose golden desk accessory set. It’s very beautiful and it looks high end on my office desk. Everything is well designed and well made. This is a must for my home office
title: Love rose gold

review: While I really liked how sturdy this product was, it was just too large and clumsy for me to use. I’m a shorter person and it felt too big for my arms. It would not sit nicely on the couch because of the sled legs. It’s made very well. Legs are adjustable and sturdy. Table adjusts to many angles. Just way to big for my lap. Would be good for the floor or standing desk maybe. Ended up returning it. Got a smaller lap table with the bean bag things for your legs.
title: Too big for my lap

review: The size of the table is very nice. The quality and fit/finish is just OK. The hinge locks do not securely hold the table in the set position. If you put to much pressure on the table it will change angles. The leg height locks are not the most secure. Accessory draw and bookshelf is again just OK. I like the slight tack feel to the table top. Just enough to keep things from sliding around. The distance between the legs is wide enough that you can sit cross leg and still have the table over your lap. To summarize. Overall a good product but some shortfalls.
title: The quality is just OK

review: This is a really nicely made and designed product with great adjustability with the exception of how low it can be adjusted to. For me it’s 2-1/2 to 3” to high to work well and can’t be lowered to just above your thighs when using it. Angling it doesn’t solve the issue so in the end maybe it can be a good standing desk for me but not in a laying down context. Hopefully they read this and consider this adjustment issue before you buy one.
title: Great in ways but low is too high to work for me

review: These are like thin textured socks for the arms of your desk chair. If they were thicker or padded they would be better. If they were smooth instead of textured they would be better. They are not sewn well at all BUT for the price they are ok enough to keep to protect the leather on the arms of my new chair until I find something better.
title: Just ok ... barely

review: I bought this to relieve tailbone pressure while sitting in my office chair and it did not help much at all.
title: Didn't really work for me

review: Comfy, and supportive. but very small. I was surprised how small it was. Sitting on my office chair it took up only about half the space. Other than the small size, it is nice. Would be good for a car or smaller chair, but not so much for an office chair.
title: Comfy, but small

review: They're a comfortable addition to my overly firm gaming chair arm rest but the velcro wrap is not a good design for 3D type arm rest.
title: Kinda nice...

review: It's not bad, but, not great. I wish it were 2" bigger. It's made for a kitchen chair, not an office chair.
title: needs 2"

review: Very strong pvc odor that lasted a long time, even after I set it outside for a week. Desk chair wheels make indentations in plastic, making it hard to roll to different positions.
title: Very strong pvc smell.

review: these were not what i was looking for, i wanted to replace castors on a hospital bedside table nice for an office chair though
title: not what i was looking for,

review: These frames are long and only have a few cuts. They are thick and hard to cut. I have a short file cabinet and these were a pain to shorten.
title: Just okay

review: Meh. It looks cool. If I staged Instagram photos, it would be a great prop.
title: Probably will only be bookshelf or desk decor

review: Not good on medium height carpet. This is fairly soft plastic. The wheels of my typical office chair make indentations and that makes it hard to roll. I constantly need to lift partially off the chair to get it moving. Might work well with very low commercial (office building) carpet.
title: Not good on medium height carpet.

review: This feels like it wasn't quite thought out enough. At its lowest, it is too high to sit at (from a regular office chair) at its highest, its too short to stand and use (I am 6 ft 6, but it is q
title: Not very stable.

review: This helps a ton. I sit on a crappy office chair for 7.5 hours 5 days a week and since using this I do feel much better
title: works well

review: I'm in a desk chair at least 6 hrs, sometimes 10 hrs. each day. I weigh about 270 & I'm 6'-1" . This chair is "O.K.", but not really great. The seat padding is very thick and comfortable, but I still use a pillow. The chair is sturdy, but not really ergonomically configured. Hopefully the chair will last, and not "wear out" in a few months BTW - One of the five casters was missing the keeper ring; customer service quickly sent replacement caster.
title: Impressive / Well Built / Not Really Comfortable

review: Nice File Cabinet. Only one issue. The files do not glide very well, they stick. But overall Nice.
title: Nice File Cabinet

review: Nice quality. Perfect fit. Not too thick - not too thin. Was laying perfectly flat after a day or two (arrived rolled up). I am very pleased with this product.
title: Perfect for my new office desk

review: Nice but chair didn't work and I reached out to the seller but they didn't accommodate. So now I have a new office chair that its features don't work. To big to ship back.
title: Not So Happy

review: I find this to be a bit of a thin piece of magnet board. Be aware that you need a perfectly flat metal space for this to work to it's full potential. I was hoping to put it on a metal door in my art studio and then remembered that they are raised panel doors and it won't really work. Too big for a filing cabinet. It would be easy to cut and that is what I may do. Cut it to fit the panels in my door. Like the different colored markers. Not the usual colors.
title: Thin

review: This is a decent monitor stand for a desk. Easy to assemble, it's very wide, which provides plenty of space for your computer and additional items. I like the storage options afforded by the small shelves, too. For the price, it's fairly good quality, but the fiber board is not all that strong.
title: Good for the Price

review: This is very sturdy. It turns a regular desk into a standing desk and does what it's supposed to. It's heavier than I expected which is fine but just be aware you won't want to put it onto anything lightweight. I've got it on top of my regular (very sturdy) desk and use it to keep from sitting all day. It's an adjustment for me but has started paying benefits. I may look into a regular standing desk in the future.
title: Very sturdy

review: These are perfect for writing down messages and notes or to-do lists, small enough to fit on my small computer desk. Easy tear.
title: Small and compact, easy tear off

review: Serves the purpose I wanted for. I have a very cheap vinyl floor where my computer desk is and it was showing warping areas just from light mopping and I was worried about my computer chair wheels on it. This was the perfect size. I got one without bumps on the other side since it is not for carpet. I got the hardwood one. Exactly what I needed.
title: Perfect over vinyl floor

review: This is a nice chair. If you have more than one, you can nest them. They look great within an office, bedroom, or a waiting room. When the girl has friends over, they can sit in the chair and roll around while she is in her office chair with wheels.
title: Nice chair for the office or in a bedroom

review: The file cabinet is good for the money. The only thing that was a little more difficult was getting the side door on so it would close smoothly. You still have to push to the left a little to get is to close but I do like the look of it and the room it has to hold a printer on top.
title: The door does not fit flush so we have to push to the left a little so it will close.

review: Bought this to use on my own books. Where I work, there are quite a few readers so I keep a bookshelf in my office where anyone can borrow a book. These came in handy to put in the books!
title: Very Cute & Fun

review: The only thing I dislike about working from home is that I miss my Herman Miller chair. Sigh. Anyway, I don't have like a grand to drop on an office chair and my vintage tanker chair started to kill my back. I took a chance on this and my back issues are gone (I don't have a serious back issue just fyi). The lumbar support is just hard plastic against the back webbing, so it's not cushy or anything, but the seat is. All in all I'm really happy with it so far (about a month in).
title: Not a Herman Miller, but good for the price

review: Fits into drawers of file cabinets I bought, will look at other styles for the other drawers
title: Four Stars

review: These bookends are flimsy. They are easy to bend when not holding books. Once they are holding books, they do great. I use these on top of a bookcase in my son’s room. He has so many books we needed to start using the top of the book case for books also! This does a good job at holding the books in place so they don’t fall down off the sides.
title: Feels Weak

review: These mood signs are fun for your office desk. The collection of pictures and sayings has a foldout base to hold it up. The pictures flip over and are two sided. So you can have one picture facing your work area and the other can face out to the rest of the office. The majority of the pictures are of cute dogs and cats.
title: Fun for Your Office Desk

review: This is such a great deal! I love this. Not only is this perfect for your laptop, but you can use it as a food tray or writing desk. It has a place to keep your cup and a little drawer to hold items. It is sturdy and really nice looking too. I highly recommend this product.
title: YOU WILL NEED TO BUY THIS!!

review: This is a good office chair. It is comfortable to sit in for long periods of time. It feels like a zero gravity chair. It isn't plush, but more like sitting in a tightly stretched hammock. Super comfortable, I promise.
title: Good Chair

review: This is a comfortable desk chair. It looks pretty nice, too. Though you do have to be a little careful with the faux leather or it'll look awful pretty fast. It is comfortable to sit in. I like it.
title: Comfortable Chair

review: I really like this pillow set. You can get great support while sitting in a non-ideal chair. For everyone shifting to working from home, you know the pain of sitting on your wooden dining room chair for way too long working on the laptop. This pillow set turns that dining room chair into an ergonomic office chair! It is comfortable to sit for long periods of time. You can even use it on a bench or in the car.
title: Support

review: Would recommend these for anyone with a gaming chair (I have DXracer), 'installation' if you even want to call it that, takes less than 30 seconds and fits on there snug. Much better than the normal arms!
title: Perfect

review: Ignore the directions and just watch the video on the Amazon page - so simple a child can do it! Detachable Headrest. The back height is adjustable, with the headrest, from the seat base to top, is 30'' to 32.3''. detached the headrest, the back is 16'' to 18.2''. The seat width between the armrests is about 20 inch. Chair support is 330 Pounds/150 kg.
title: Highback Mesh Desk Chair, Tilt, Swivel, Adjustable Armrest, Lumbar Support by Tdbest

review: The directions were simple and minimal, but the one one but thing was hard to get. Also, the knob to hold the neck rest on came with part of the plastic shattered. Other than that, this is a good chair (especially for the price). It fits in a small space and is very comfortable. I was sitting on an old wood desk chair (that was my great grandfather's). While that chair is nice for the history, it's not good to sit in for a 10 hour work day. I'm glad I found this!
title: Comfy chair, easy assembly

review: I have a library and more books than shelf space. I got these to put the books that couldn't fit on the top shelf of the bookcase. These are so sturdy. The books are fully supported and I'm not nervous about the bookends giving way.
title: The perfect fit

review: I am a writer - and before having this filing cabinet - I had stacks of my work lying around everyplace. Now, it is all neat and tidy and alphabetized.
title: I am a writer - and before having this filing ...

review: I should have bought 2 sets of these. one for me and one for the granddaughters. I would have more left for what I actually bought them for. they do make very nice doll clothes clip together by which doll sortation devices. and what can I tell you about the way they hold up sheets from the bookcase to the dresser to facilitate tent perfection????? I do have 2 for clipping chip bags . . . . so far.
title: i should have bought 2 sets

review: I helped my old dad assemble it and between the two of us we got it lol. It's a very nice sturdy rolling file cabinet. Very big inside and perfect to till up next to his desk and go through without straining to bend to lower drawers of old cabinet. It's so easy to roll place to place.
title: Was a great present to my dad

review: I bought this metal base because the office chair I have is great, but the plastic base broke where one of the swivel wheels is mounted. It was a hassle trying to get the old plastic base off the standard size 2" dia. center mounting stem (had to use a hack saw) but after that the new base went together easily (the five legs are solidly mounted to the center spider), the swivel wheels were transferred from the old base to the new (all bases use standard 7/16" dia stems) and the chair center mounting stem pushed into this new base. The new base feels really solid - love it.
title: Really solid

review: Installed these on a typical office chair: 1) they fit into the chair legs because all chairs have a standard shaft size and 2) the large diameter wheels easily go over carpet.
title: Work Great on Carpet

review: I bought these to allow my office chair to move on carpet without a plastic sheet - and they work fine.
title: Work great on carpet

review: This office chair is very comfortable. It’s easy to assemble and the whole process only took me about 20 min. And it’s very sturdy with excellent quality. It’s adjustable and very pretty
title: Comfortable chair

review: The file cabinet is as was expected, and simple to put on the wheels. Easy-peasy, nice-looking, functional, and I am pleased with this purchase.
title: As expected.

review: Bought for my home office since covid has everyone working from home. My gf uses it for her 10+ hour shifts doing customer service. She loves it and its completely relieved her back pain from our old cheap office chair that only went to her mid back. It was super easy to put together, we did it in about 15 minutes. I was a little disappointed the "chrome" is just plastic. It chipped a little when we were putting it together. Our cats have gotten it dirty a couple times and its easy to wipe down, so thats nice. Hopefully it holds up for a while.
title: Comfortable and easy to clean!

review: Took some time and two to put together but overall would buy again. Sturdy, looks good but finish on top does mark easily. Gave up on the lock which we would not use anyway.
title: Z-line lateral file cabinet

review: Broke my ankle and had to be non-weight bearing so no putting my foot down at all for 6 weeks. All that sitting and laying down elevating and icing my ankle etc. had my bum hurting almost as much as my ankle! Even my soft couch was hurting my tailbone, felt like I was sutting on concrete. This pillow worked well to alleviate the pressure while I was zooming around my house in my office chair and while sitting on the couch. Would recomnend.
title: Tailbone - ouch!

review: I was desperate for a chair as my previous regular office chair had broken the night before. Asked for next day delivery and gotten it! Honestly not sure how people were able to build this thing in 30 minutes unless they had an extra set of hands. It took me well over an hour by myself and the instructions were a bit difficult to figure out as there were only two words on it - "Assembly Instructions" which is the only reason why I took off 1 star. Otherwise, this chair is more comfy than it looks and feels very sturdy.
title: Quick delivery and once you have it built, best chair for the price!

review: needed to upgrade two of our office chairs. i didnt even realize they sell replacements.. i guess thats amazon for you haha great buy!
title: just what we needed!

review: Got this as a gift for someone and it was their first actual desk chair, before this just had normal chairs for working at a computer and they have definitely thanked me and enjoyed this one. Great comfort.
title: First good chair

review: I needed a stand for my monitor as one was shorter than the other and did not adjust. This stand gave me some room for odds and ends that normally get lost in the small drawer available at my desk. I only get one drawer for "stuff" and this definitely gave me more room. The drawers slide in and out well and it is sturdy to hold the monitor. I would recommend.
title: monitor stand and extra space

review: This office chair has a mash back, which is nice because it keeps your back from sweating. The seat is padded. Not a huge amount of padding, but acceptable. The arms on this chair will raise and lower. There is no padding on the armrests. There is a headrest which can be removed if desired. Nice lumbar support. Assembly is fairly straightforward. This chair is made in China and being sold by Chinese company on Amazon.
title: Made in China. Nice for a basic office chair.

review: This office chair has both a mesh as well as a mesh back and headrest. This makes it a bit “bouncy” when you sit on it. This chair has a 300# weight limit. The armrests are adjustable. Nice lumbar support. This office chair is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current cost of 266 bucks.. . It’s at least 100 bucks overpriced. There are a ton of different Chinese companies selling (overpriced) office chairs right now on Amazon, so make sure you take a look around before purchasing.
title: Made in China. Overpriced, but a nice office chair overall.

review: This is the type of office chair which offers a mash back, which is nice and breathable. It has a padded seat, and there is a fairly nice amount of padding. As you can see from the listing videos… It is fairly easy to assemble. No extra tools required. The armrests are adjustable, which is nice. The lumbar support has some adjustability to it as well. The listing shows that it has a weight limit of 330 pounds. This office chair is made in China and being sold by Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of 316 bucks it’s at least twice the price it should be, but overall I like it.
title: Made in China. Overpriced, but I nice chair overall.

review: This whimsical birthday card for a little girl is one she will certainly put on her bookcase or hang on her wall! Being that it’s not just a square card, but a cutout is a great touch. Foil embellishments on the front make it shine and shimmer. This size is nice at 8.2 x 5”. A fuchsia envelope is included, so this card will stick-out from the start! Overall a great birthday card for a little girl.
title: Cute birthday card for a little girl

review: What a nice executive chair, high back, wide and comfortable. It was a great price as well.
title: Office chair

review: The new computer desk I bought had a bit of a sharp corner on the edge, and it was irritating my wrists. I ordered this to rest my wrists on to keep them off of the corner of the desk. It definitely helped. I don't notice the problem with my wrists and longer. As with all of these I have ever seen, the fabric on the outside tends to come loose from the gel, so it won't last forever, but it works for now.
title: Nice padding

review: The best office chair wheels I've ever owned. Their design gets around the problems of picking up dust and hair which eventually preventsp the dual wheels rolling smoothly. This roll VERY smoothly. I liked it so much I bought a pair for my wife's computer chair. The downside is they only retain their high mobility for a year or so. Then they get sluggish. But they still protect the floor from scratched harder wheels make. I JUST ordered a replacement pair and got them today.
title: The best office chair wheels I've ever owned.

review: Replacing another version that I had. This one is lighter weight and slightly smaller, but still fits my HP Probook with room for my mouse. I use as a standing desk as needed at work. Easy to raise and adjust…almost too easy. When I unfold the legs, one side always tends to extend. Minor inconvenience that is easy to overcome.
title: Works well. Roomy

review: These armrest pads are comfortable, and well made. I especially like that they having cooling gel built in. However, I couldn't use them on my office chair because the arms on that chair are too skinny.
title: Not for skinny armed chairs

review: I often prefer to stand while working, and this really helps me to do that! I can also roll it up to my standing desk bike so I can either stand or bike while working. It's super sturdy and well made, heavy though. It was a little work to assemble and not as easy as it should be to lift or lower, so I try to use it raised as much as possible.
title: Great mobile cart for working

review: This is a fairly comfortable desk chair, but not for all day use. If you need something for a couple hours a day, this will do nicely. It isn't the strongest, so won't last more than a couple years. If you're looking for all day office chairs that will hold up for years, look for Ergohuman brand
title: Ok chair for short periods of time
